As @POTUS noted, thanks to extraordinary progress, we have more tools than ever to prevent & detect cancer.

That's why last year I introduced my Medicare Multi-Cancer Early Detection Screening Coverage Act to ensure that Americans can access these life-saving technologies! https://t.co/RWZrraqGuc

Yes! @POTUS is right—Catching cancer early saves lives.

My Multi-Cancer Early Detection Screening Coverage Act would ensure that Medicare covers new, innovative blood-based cancer screenings after they are FDA-approved so that Americans can catch cancer before it spreads!

Today, I recognize a man who wakes up every day to beat the drum for justice. Bryan Stevenson founded the Equal Justice Initiative in Montgomery to provide legal representation to those who have been denied fair and just treatment in the legal system. #BlackHistoryMonth https://t.co/DZKtHN8FDc

Today marks one year since @POTUS signed the historic #AmericanRescuePlan into law which rescued our people & economy and delivered relief to our cities, schools, small businesses, hospitals, and families.

Take a look at how this transformational law impacted us in Alabama!👇🏾 https://t.co/DMQe6P3B6z

12 years ago today, President Obama signed the Affordable Care Act into law. Thanks to its lifesaving protections, 30+ MILLION Americans have gained affordable coverage. In Congress, I will continue to safeguard this law and work to lower health care costs for all Alabamians! https://t.co/THAhUUhZik

Now more than ever, there is a dire need for better awareness and treatment options for Americans living with kidney conditions.

Read my op-ed about why we must transform kidney care care in America and how my bill would help us do it. https://t.co/ads7cHkGX4

Like so many hospitals across AL, Hill Hospital is facing challenges which have only been made worse by COVID-19. This funding will be used to improve facilities and purchase new equipment so that providers can continue to deliver excellent care to the residents of Sumter County! https://t.co/bkTcVjrK1r

Last night, I tested positive for COVID-19 and am experiencing mild symptoms. I am grateful to have received both vaccinations and the booster shot and looking forward to a full and speedy recovery.

This is a good reminder to protect yourself by getting vaccinated and boosted!

NEWS: Today, I led my @NewDemCoalition colleagues in a letter to congressional leadership about why we MUST pass a reconciliation bill that extends the #AmericanRescuePlan's enhanced ACA subsidies and closes the Medicaid coverage gap. (1/2) https://t.co/z9CUGaPVPR

.@RepTerriSewell The ARP's enhanced premium tax credits helped lower health care costs and get more people covered than ever before. Letting these subsidies expire would threaten to undo our progress, drive up costs, and strip Americans of their coverage. We must act NOW! (2/2)

BIG NEWS! My Medicare Multi-Cancer Early Detection Screening Coverage Act which I introduced with @RepArrington, @RepRaulRuizMD, & @RepRichHudson is now supported by over HALF of my colleagues in the House! This milestone brings us one step closer to seeing this bill become law!

Honored to be among @preventcancer’s ‘22 Cancer Champions for our work to advance the Multi-Cancer Early Detection Screening Coverage Act.

The fight against cancer is personal for me and I’m committed to harnessing our bipartisan momentum to get this bill across the finish line!

$1 million from the Department of Health and Human Services will help combat the opioid crisis by making treatment and recovery services more accessible to rural Alabamians.

I’ll continue fighting for more resources and better opportunities for the people of our district!

My staff was proud to join the Rural Health Alabama Prevention Center for the 4th annual Health and Wellness Conference. 

I look forward to our continued partnership to expand access to vital healthcare services for the thousands of residents in Alabama’s rural communities! https://t.co/KvZLgSPq2i

Supporting Rural Hospitals 🏥 

The “Support Rural Hospitals Act” which I co-led with Rep. Tom Reed will provide a lifeline to rural hospitals by extending the Medicare low-volume hospital payment adjustment for two years through September 30, 2024.

Expanding Access to Mental Health Services ⚕️

My “Access to Mental Health Services Act” will expand access to mental health services, identify gaps in mental health coverage under private insurance, and help providers better treat patients experiencing a mental health crisis.

#ThrowbackThursday: Last week, Team Sewell was in Lowndes County for the Wellness Rocks Senior Health Expo! 

Our seniors are such a vibrant part of the 7th District, and I will continue to fight for them every day in Congress! 💕 https://t.co/WF1Tp37UhY

Just toured the Good Samaritan Hospital where the Foot Soldiers sought treatment on Bloody Sunday and where my two twin brothers were born.

With the help of @AuburnU & @GeorgiaTech we’re working to revitalize this building to bring more housing and economic development to Selma! https://t.co/3MjN6Jfxd7

We in Congress must do more to improve prevention, education & treatment of chronic kidney disease.

That’s why @RepCarolMiller and I introduced the Chronic Kidney Disease Improvement in Research and Treatment Act.

Read our op-ed in @rollcall!
https://t.co/npJqjogQcW

Wow!! A record 21 million Americans have enrolled in coverage through the Affordable Care Act during 2024 Open Enrollment! 🙌🏾

The American people have made it clear—they don’t want Republicans to repeal this law. Let’s keep fighting to improve it! https://t.co/jSAQM426Zi

It should go without saying but in the United States of America, women should not have to fear being prosecuted and criminalized for their pregnancy outcomes.

My Democratic colleagues and I sent a letter to @POTUS urging him to protect patients against pregnancy criminalization.

On #WorldCancerDay we recognize the work we must do to address the #1 killer of older Americans. Proud to be leading the Nancy Gardner Sewell Medicare MCED Screening Coverage Act—named for my mother—which is a critical step in shifting the cancer paradigm and catching it early!

Great to welcome @CDCDirector Dr. Mandy Cohen to Birmingham and highlight our local efforts around substance abuse treatment and overdose prevention.

We also discussed our shared mission of combating gun violence, environmental injustice, maternal mortality, and cancer. https://t.co/wKHVjOxUkS

Today I was proud to convene @AAMCtoday, @UABNews, @marshallu, and @BJC_HealthCare for a briefing about the need to #ExpandGME so that we can address the physician shortage and save lives.

Congress should pass my Resident Physician Shortage Reduction Act!

It is because of stories like these that I am proud to be leading the charge to pass the Nancy Gardner Sewell Medicare #MCED Screening Coverage Act.

#MCED tests can save lives, and Americans deserve access!
https://t.co/AEDPyWV8nB
